from pandas import Timedelta, date_range, DatetimeIndex
from pandas.tseries.offsets import (
    CustomBusinessDay,
    CustomBusinessMonthBegin,
    CustomBusinessMonthEnd,
)

offset_classes = {
    "CustomBusinessDay": CustomBusinessDay,
    "CustomBusinessMonthBegin": CustomBusinessMonthBegin,
    "CustomBusinessMonthEnd": CustomBusinessMonthEnd,
}

for unit in ["s", "ms"]:
    dti = date_range("2016-01-01", periods=3, freq="D", unit=unit)
    for name, cls in offset_classes.items():
        off = cls(offset=Timedelta(microseconds=500))
        expected = DatetimeIndex([x + off for x in dti], dtype="datetime64[us]")
        try:
            res = dti + off
            diff = float(abs(res.astype("datetime64[us]").asi8 - expected.asi8).max())
            micro = float(res[0].microsecond)
            is_us = 1.0 if str(res.dtype) == "datetime64[us]" else 0.0
        except Exception:
            diff = 1e9
            micro = -1.0
            is_us = -1.0
        probe(unit + "_" + name + "_max_abs_diff_us", diff)
        probe(unit + "_" + name + "_first_element_microsecond", micro)
        probe(unit + "_" + name + "_result_is_us", is_us)
